scope: horizontal source registration only, not terrain or navigation

mesh.coordinates: original GLTF world X,Z, before standalone viewer normalization

fit.selection: Mean horizontal position of the 182 source mesh vertices above world Y=125; independently identified main dome centre in the native plan.
Highest mesh point within radius 5 of world XZ=[284,0]; centre of the square obelisk symbol in the native plan.

holdout.selection: Horizontal centre of the mesh fountain crown, checked against its top-view footprint; centre of the separate northern fountain symbol, not used in fitting.
Top point of the southern mesh fountain, checked against its top-view footprint; centre of the southern fountain symbol, not used in fitting.

constraints: One uniform horizontal scale and rotation; never independent X/Z stretching.
Mesh altitude is preserved internally. The flat campus context is placed below the mesh's minimum as a display plane, not a common site elevation.
Braccio Nuovo is not included in this fit. Its historical-to-current horizontal registration and common vertical datum remain unaccepted.
